saw_lines: Breakfast buyers pick one oat product they trust, then reorder it every week without comparing.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before a new buyer decides the oats are worth trying.
Your 10 of 26 ads run the same copy, so keep the body, rewrite each opening line and creative, then test two new angles against the baked oats line.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 16 Oct 2026
points: The same copy runs in 10 of 26 ads, so buyers tune it out. Keep the body text but rewrite each opening line and creative. Test two new angles against it, one on 20 grams of protein, one on 100 calories.
None of your 26 copy ads carries a proof number, so buyers have nothing to trust. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

10 of 26 ads open on baked oats, while your next opener leads only 5. New angles never get a fair test against that line. Test two new openers against it, one on the 3 minute breakfast, one on brownie taste.

Your ads push the free topping and the free shaker, but a first time buyer sees no price reason to act today. Lead one of three new ads with a first order offer, and keep the shaker as the closing line.
